run_train_job: run the SAM3 training job with a Hydra config file on local or SLURM cluster
launch_submitit_cluster: launch distributed training jobs on a SLURM cluster via Submitit with configurable partitions
build_job_array: build a SLURM job array of multiple training tasks with individual configs and ports
run_single_node: run single-node multi-GPU training with spawn-based multiprocessing for CUDA compatibility
summarize_submitit_runner: summarize the SubmititRunner class that wraps trainer instantiation and SLURM job execution
